objective: This folder is empty. Build a command-line to-do app in Python using only the standard library, run as `python todo.py COMMAND`. `add TEXT` saves a task and prints `Added ID: TEXT`; ids start at 1 and are never reused. `list` prints one line per task in id order, `[ ] ID TEXT` when open and `[x] ID TEXT` when done, or `No tasks` when there are none; `list --open` shows only open tasks. `done ID` marks a task done and `remove ID` deletes it. An unknown id, a missing argument or an unknown command prints a message to stderr and exits with code 1. Tasks are stored in todo.json in the current folder, or in the file named by the TODO_FILE environment variable. Text can contain any Unicode. Add your own tests.
